rv.q: This savage, hilarious, incredibly sad work- now transferred from the Royal Court to the West End- is the best new play of the year.
It's a vicious, funny play, stained with nicotine and nihilism.
McDonagh's exquisite comic timing sparkles everywhere here, in each line and half-line, every beat and riposte.
Yet this is a play that is easier to admire than to love.
This is a darkly funny new play that has an off-the-scale hit rate in terms of wicked one-liners.

cn.t: Critics praise Hangmen as a masterful return for McDonagh, with David Morrissey's performance and razor-sharp black comedy earning strong acclaim across the board.
